messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ALERT · smart-routing fallback flapping detected for customer-prod (high impact) · 5xx spike · paging emma (oncall) · http://redwood.internal/incidents/2271234567 :rotating_light:
emma (oncall): on it. seeing increased 5xx for model-route 'assistant-large' routed -> variant 'a_quant' -> fallback to 'a_fp16' -> loop, appears to oscillate between eu-west and us-west pools. pulling traces now.
raj (sre): can you confirm traffic mix? is tool-calling being used? toolcalls won't work on quant variant, that could cause errors.
emma (oncall): quick glance at trace: many requests include tool-call metadata header `x-rw-toolcall:1` and then route to a_quant which errors with "unsupported op: tool_call_v2" and triggers fallback. fallback routing policy then marks a_fp16 as degraded in eu-west because of lat spikes and sends traffic to us-west where a_quant is preferred — loop.
mike (eng-runtime): copying logs from routing-agent, partial tail:
```
[2271234567.001] route decision: customer-prod -> smart-route policy v3
[2271234567.002] candidate: a_quant (eu-west) compat: quant(yes) tool_call(support:NO) context_max=4096
[2271234567.003] request meta: tool_call=1 context_len=1200
[2271234567.004] a_quant -> runtime error: UnsupportedKernel: tool_call_v2
[2271234567.004] fallback -> a_fp16 (us-west)
[2271234567.005] a_fp16 -> success
[2271234567.006] routing health mark: eu-west:a_fp16=DEGRADED (latency)
[2271234567.007] next request -> prefer eu-west:a_quant
```
raj (sre): that matches. root cause hypothesis: compatibility matrix indicates a_quant does not support tool calling but smart-routing policy ignores tool_call capability when selecting variant for this org due to a recent policy refactor.
anne (ml-infra): confirmed — compatibility-matrix service recently had a missing field for quant variants after the schema migration. `supports_tool_call` defaulted to false, but when the matrix is partially stale for eu-west it was returning null and policy code treated null as "unknown -> assume supported". bad.
emma (oncall): paging on-call switchover: @mike you take lead for runtime mitigation, @anne handle matrix hotfix, @raj coordinate mitigation and customer comms, @sara prep CS templated message. i'll stay on until handoff.
sara (support): drafting message for affected customers: short blurb about increased 5xx and degraded performance, mitigation underway, ETA ~30m. will post after check-in.
mike (eng-runtime): temporary mitigation: disabling smart-routing policy for customer-prod and pinning to a_fp16 in us-west to stop oscillation. deploying config now.
```
curl -XPOST http://config-service/set -d '{"org":"customer-prod","route":"pin:a_fp16:us-west"}'
```
deploy-bot: config update started (job 5543) by mike
deploy-bot: config update complete (job 5543) — 3 nodes updated
mike (eng-runtime): pin applied. traffic now stable to us-west a_fp16. observability shows 5xx dropping.
raj (sre): good. mitigation successful. can we keep pin for 1 hour while anne fixes matrix and we validate matrix semantics across regions?
anne (ml-infra): working on schema patch. fix: ensure `supports_tool_call` is explicit boolean and policy treats null as false. rolling patch to compatibility-matrix service -> staging -> prod. ETA 18m.
oliver (product): any customer-visible feature regressions from pin? will that affect latency for some customers used to eu-west? need to inform SLA holders.
emma (oncall): note for comms: impacted customers in EU may see slightly higher latency while pinned to us-west. sara please include latency note + apology.
sara (support): message ready: "We're seeing intermittent 5xx for LLM routing due to a compatibility mismatch in our variant selection logic. We've pinned affected customers to a stable variant; a fix for the compatibility service is rolling out now. Expect recovery within 30–40 minutes. We'll follow up with a root-cause postmortem." send? :thinking:
emma (oncall): send. also open an internal incident channel for RCA after this.
sara (support): sent to affected customers and status page updated: "Investigating -> Mitigated (partial)".
anne (ml-infra): prod patch applied to compatibility-matrix (build 1.12.3). verifying cross-region matrix reads.
```
GET /compatibility-matrix?model=assistant-large&variant=a_quant
=> {"supports_tool_call": false, "context_limit": 8192, "quantized": true}
```
anne (ml-infra): matrix now returns explicit false in both eu-west and us-west. policy updated in staging to treat null as false; will push to prod in 6m.
mike (eng-runtime): can revert pin once policy uses explicit false check. running A/B on policy in canary.
raj (sre): monitoring: error rate back to baseline over last 3 minutes. watching for flapping.
emma (oncall): prepping handoff to raj for next 2 hours. raj you'll be primary — confirm when you have eyes and acceptance.
raj (sre): I have it. will monitor for 1 hour and then rotate to next oncall. documenting timeline in incident tracker.
emma (oncall): few follow-ups: 1) postmortem once incident closed, include schema migration steps and tests to assert `supports_tool_call` presence 2) add unit test in routing policy to assert null treated as false 3) improve canary for compatibility-matrix schema changes 4) correlate customers affected list and billing impact.
oliver (product): please include customer list, latency delta and any token-level cost impact in the postmortem.
sara (support): Customer comms updated to include ETA and follow-up promise. will join RCA call.
raj (sre): closing the page for now, keeping the incident open; will mark resolved after 1h stable and postmortem linked.
incidents-bot: Incident 2271234567 status: MITIGATED (routing pinned) · owner: raj (sre) · next_update: 2026-03-15T16:02:00Z"
